register.title: Open an account
register.body: Pick an empty lot on the plat for your first building. Being near the center makes your missions arrive sooner and cost less.
register.pick: Tap an empty lot on the plat.

entry.title: Enter the city
entry.body: Your account is kept with a passkey: your device's fingerprint, face or PIN. No passwords and nothing to pay.
entry.passkeyNote: When you found, your device asks you to create the passkey and then to confirm it. If your passkey syncs (iCloud, Google), you can sign in from your other devices too.
entry.otherDevice: Already have an account on another device?
entry.otherDeviceNote: If your passkey does not sync to this device (another brand, say), create one here and approve it from a device that already has the account.
entry.join: Add this device to my account
entry.recoverNote: Lost your devices? With your recovery code, this device creates a new passkey and gets into your account.

session.title: This device
session.note: This device plays for you without asking for your passkey on every order. The permission expires by itself; renewing it asks for the passkey once.
session.lapsed: Expired: your next order asks for the passkey
session.revoke: Remove the permission and sign out

book.perUnit: Costs and times are per troop.
book.researchHere: Research is running in another building.
book.needSchool: The Specialization School is needed to research.
book.noRoom: The training room for these troops is needed.

missions.title: Missions
missions.noTroops: No attack troops in this building.
missions.hiddenNote: The kind and target stay hidden until arrival. Travel time and salary use a random cover distance, so they do not give the target away.
missions.publicNote: Transports for a market order travel in the open.
missions.noRoom: The destination cannot store: {{list}}. What does not fit is lost: having room is the receiver's responsibility.
missions.incomingOverflow: not everything fits: make room before it lands
missions.forecastNote: Computed for the arrival from what is known today: production, queues and known missions. It does not count other players' hidden missions or what anyone does before then.

family.title: Family
family.none: You are not in a family.
family.name: Name

market.title: Market
market.fair: Fair price at the fixed rates
market.unfair: The price matches no fixed rate (3-5-1 or 2-4-1).
market.rates: 1 dollar = 3 weapons = 5 ammunition (3-5-1) or 2 weapons = 4 ammunition (2-4-1)
market.vacationLocked: No vacation while an accepted trade's window is open:
market.depositFrom: The deposit leaves the building you are in
market.escrowNote: When the buyer accepts, the seller's goods and a {{percent}}% deposit of the price are held in the trade. The buyer pays with transports that must arrive within {{days}} days and withdraws the goods as it pays. Once the window closes, the seller withdraws the unsold rest and the unpaid share of the deposit. Shares never expire.
market.offerNote: The goods leave that building when the buyer accepts; it must hold them then.
market.sharesLeft: You have a share left in a finished trade: withdraw it to offer or accept again.
market.withdrawNote: Each amount has to fit in your share and in the building's free capacity; otherwise the transaction reverts.
market.withdrawNone: Nothing fits in that building right now: make room or choose another one.

account.title: Account
account.vacationNote: While you are on vacation nobody can send you missions and you cannot play; production and queues keep running. Without premium it lasts {{free}} days and then you wait {{freeCooldown}}; with premium it lasts {{premium}} and the wait is {{premiumCooldown}}.
account.vacationCooldown: You can go on vacation again from
account.noPremium: No premium: one room, one research and one troop batch per queue, and shorter vacations.
account.transferNote: The whole account (buildings, troops, family, trades) moves to that address. It takes {{days}} days and then the destination address has to accept it; meanwhile any device of the account can cancel it.
account.transferPendingBanner: A transfer of the account to {{to}} is pending: it can be accepted from {{when}}.

dev.title: Workshop (local only)
dev.warpStopped: Time stopped at the arrival of a hidden mission that could not be revealed; wait for the keeper and go on.

errors.AlreadyRegistered: This address already has an account.
errors.SlotTaken: That lot already has an owner.
errors.TimingRoomRequired: The required room is missing (level 1 or more).
errors.ResearchElsewhere: You are already researching in another building.
errors.NothingToCancel: There is nothing to void there.
errors.Backlog: The mission queue is catching up; try again in a few seconds.
errors.OwnTarget: You cannot attack your own building.
errors.CargoExceeded: The cargo exceeds the capacity (after the salary).
errors.LastBuilding: You cannot abandon your last building.
errors.TargetOnVacation: The owner of that building is on vacation.
errors.VacationCooldown: The wait since your last vacation is not over yet.
errors.MissionsInFlight: You cannot go on vacation with missions travelling.
errors.ControllerTaken: That address already controls another account.
errors.InvalidName: Tag of 2 to 8 and name of 2 to 35 characters, ASCII only.
errors.NameTaken: That tag or name already exists.
errors.NotAllowed: Your rank does not allow it.
errors.AlreadyApplied: You already applied to that family.
errors.NoOffer: There is no offer to answer.
errors.NotController: That can only be done by confirming with your passkey.
errors.SessionTooLong: The permission can't last that long.
errors.noAccount: That passkey has no account in this city.
errors.TooManyControllers: The account already has 5 devices or codes: remove one first.
errors.LastController: You cannot remove the account's last device.
errors.RemovalPending: That removal cannot be completed yet: wait for the date shown.
errors.NoRemoval: There is no pending removal for that device.
errors.TransferPending: The transfer cannot be completed yet: wait for the date shown.
errors.invalidCode: That code does not belong to any account.
errors.BadReveal: The revealed target does not match the mission.
errors.InvalidCover: The cover distance is not valid for that target.
errors.TradeOpen: You cannot start a vacation while an accepted trade's window is open.
errors.InvalidWithdrawal: The withdrawal does not fit: check what is left for you in the trade and the building's free capacity.
errors.SharesLeft: You have a share left in a finished trade: withdraw it before offering or accepting.
errors.TooManyTrades: You already have 10 trades as buyer.
errors.NoInvite: There is no valid invitation for this address.
errors.TooLate: The send took too long to land for the mission's fixed arrival: send it again.
errors.InvalidArrival: The mission's fixed arrival is too far off: send it again.
errors.TroopsResting: The newly arrived troops are resting: the building cannot send a mission yet.
errors.OutOfOrder: A hidden mission that arrived before this one has to be revealed first: wait a few seconds.
errors.TooEarly: Too early: the reveal grace of that mission has not passed yet.

joining.title: Add this device
joining.body: Scan this code (or open the link) on a device that already has the account, and approve it with its passkey. Once it invites you, the button to accept shows up here.
joining.invited: Account #{{player}} invited you. Accept to join (asks for your passkey once).

devices.title: Devices and recovery
devices.note: Each device with its passkey, and each recovery code, manages the whole account; up to 5. Removing this device is immediate. Removing another one takes {{days}} days: it ends the permission to play on all of them right away (the others renew it with their passkey) and, meanwhile, anyone in the account can cancel it.
devices.confirmRemove: Remove {{who}}? It will no longer manage the account.
devices.confirmSchedule: Request removing {{who}}? It completes only in {{days}} days; meanwhile any device of the account can cancel it.
devices.pendingSelf: Someone asked to remove this device: it can be completed on {{when}}. If it was not you, cancel it and check your other devices and codes.
devices.usedHere: used to recover on this device
devices.usedNote: That code was already used to recover the account: generate a new one and remove the used one.
devices.addNote: On the new device choose “Add this device to my account”: it shows a QR code. Scan it with this device, or paste its link here; then accept the invitation on the new device.
devices.link: Link or address of the new device
devices.approve: A device asks to join your account
devices.approveNote: It invites it to manage the whole account: the new device then accepts the invitation. Invite it only if you are setting it up yourself.
devices.recoveryNote: If you lose your devices, this code recovers the account from a new one. Keep it off this device (on paper or in a password manager): whoever has it can take the account.
devices.invited: Device invited: it has to accept from its own screen
devices.pendingNote: Nobody can add this address to an account unless you accept here. Accepting asks for your passkey once.

guide.intro: Build, produce, recruit and expand your territory. Here are the basics to get started.
guide.office: Upgrade the Boss Office to reduce room construction times in that building.
guide.school: The Mob School enables research. Higher levels shorten research times in that building.
guide.camp: The camp lets you recruit troops. Upgrade it to shorten training times in that building.
guide.resources: Production rooms generate resources over time. Upgrade storage rooms to increase capacity: when storage is full, you stop accumulating that resource.
guide.alcohol: The brewery produces alcohol. The bar consumes it to generate dollars; without enough alcohol, income drops or stops. Upgrade the brewery to keep it supplied.
guide.expansion: An occupation troop lets you occupy an empty lot and is usually sent alone, without a combat escort. One unit is consumed on success. You can then send resource transports to develop the new building.
guide.optional: Play your own way. These steps are optional, and you can reopen this guide from “How to play”.
guide.recommendation: A suggested path to expand from {{coord}}. Keep playing your own way; the steps reflect your current progress.
guide.complete: You already own more than one building. You can keep expanding with more occupation troops.
guide.cost: Cost of the next upgrade or unit:
guide.researchElsewhere: You have research in another building. You can finish it there before continuing here.
guide.capacity: The {{resource}} cost exceeds your capacity. Next step toward more storage:
guide.short: You need {{amount}} more {{resource}}. Wait for production or upgrade its production room:
guide.chooseLot: Choose an empty lot on the map and send one occupation troop alone. Check the salary and travel time. To supply the new building, send a separate resource transport afterward: it must arrive once the lot has been occupied.
guide.travel: Your expedition is on its way. Occupation succeeds if the lot is still empty on arrival.
guide.map: Choose a lot on the map

0.title: A productive start
0.why: Prioritize ammunition and upgrade the office to 2 to speed up early construction without spending too much on it.

1.title: Invest in production
1.why: Raise ammunition production to 12 first; then open the bar and strengthen weapons production.

2.title: Production and capacity
2.why: Work toward ammunition 14 and weapons 9. Build storage rooms and the safe at level 1 to afford large upgrades and the occupation troop.

3.title: Income for expansion
3.why: Brewery 8 and office 5 unlock Smuggle. Upgrade it to 2 and weapons production to 10 before focusing on expansion.

4.title: Prepare for occupation
4.why: Once your economy is established, build the school at level 1. Research Routing to 5 while upgrading the camp to 2 to shorten troop training.

5.title: Your first expansion
5.why: Gather 20,000 weapons, 10,000 ammunition and 20,000 dollars. Train one occupation troop and send it alone to an empty lot. You can then supply the new building with resource transports.

guide.parallel: In parallel: use the other queue.
guide.upgradeCost: Cost of the next upgrade, to level {{level}}:
guide.shortWait: You need {{amount}} more {{resource}}. Your current production will accumulate it; you do not need to exceed the recommended levels for this goal.
guide.smuggle: Smuggle also consumes alcohol to generate dollars, more efficiently than the bar. To unlock it you need {{requirements}}. Upgrade the brewery to supply both and maintain your income.
guide.raiding: You can change this order to raid: build the training camp earlier and recruit some rowdies and transport units to attack other players and bring back their resources. Raiding can greatly accelerate early growth; results depend on the targets you find and combat losses.
guide.queueWait: Waiting for earlier jobs in this queue.

build.title: Build your economy
build.body: Start with ammunition production. Follow the recommendation in your building to find the next room upgrade.

produce.title: Keep resources flowing
produce.body: Resources accumulate over time. Increase storage before it fills up, or production will stop accumulating.

return.title: Queue work, then come back
return.body: Room upgrades take time. Check the balance and upcoming entries when you return; research and troops come as you grow.
